description: This PHP source file defines the AssignLeaveController class within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. The controller extends an abstract Vue controller and sets a leave assignment component during the preRender phase.

classes.name: AssignLeaveController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for managing leave assignment view logic within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It extends AbstractVueController and initializes a Vue component for leave assignment.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the controller state before rendering by creating and setting a Vue component named 'leave-assign'.
